text: You’re reading the same log twice. I’m asking what else you have.

speaker: Director Sorrell
text: Then ask who touched the glass after it was poured. You still haven’t shown me where the coolant came from.

speaker: Mika
text: Look—every stall has its own light again. The registry lists us as occupied, and the billboard upstairs has gone dark. That's three excuses the patrols can't use tonight. Your skewer's getting cold.

speaker: Hacked Lab Terminal
text: Corrected trial retained: the worker-shaped maintenance target crosses unharmed; the armed drone target takes the burst. Operator telemetry has been scrubbed from the roof relay. Calibration reward already issued.

speaker: System
text: [The recorder sends the confession and evidence to salon security. Two guards take Sorrell’s credentials and seat him under guard to await transport. Lyra asks Dax to keep a copy of Malick’s audit.]

speaker: Nova
text: [Nova cups her hands around the little flame.] If we lose sight of each other up there, say something I’ll recognize.

speaker: Zeke
text: Your left boot squeaks. I’ve been listening to it since the mine.

speaker: Gh0st
text: [Gh0st rests one hand on the bridge.] I’ll be close enough to hear it.

speaker: Orion
text: Then I’ll listen for four sets of footsteps.

speaker: Nova
text: Four, all the way across.

speaker: Jed
text: [A wrench taps twice against the bench.] Hold the light a little higher, kid. There. Knew you’d get it.

speaker: Nova
text: I know what you say next. I’ve been trying to remember how you said it.

speaker: Vale
text: Open the door. You can hear him say it tomorrow, too.

speaker: Nova
text: [Her hand stays on the latch.] I want to. That’s what scares me.

options.text: Let go of the latch. “I miss him. Leave him as he was.”
Step away for now.

speaker: Orion
text: [Orion touches the unbroken hull.] The cargo pod you came down in. There’s no damage.

speaker: Vale
text: A clear launch. No impact. You and Zeke reach safety.

speaker: Orion
text: You never reach Sector 9. My pod stays closed.

speaker: Nova
text: We found you. I’m keeping that.

options.text: Keep the journey that brought the crew together.
Step away for now.

speaker: Vale
text: There’s no assembly line on this side. Cross over. No one will ask what you did in the Foundry.

speaker: Gh0st
text: There were people behind that glass. Do they get to cross?

speaker: Vale
text: You won’t remember the glass.

speaker: Gh0st
text: [Gh0st takes his hand off the rail.] Then who goes back for them?

options.text: “We go back with you.” Let Gh0st turn away.
Step away for now.

speaker: Orion
text: [Orion brushes the dust from one of the names.] I used to pass this one without saying it. I was afraid I’d get it wrong.

speaker: Orion
text: Say it with me. Take a breath between the names.

speaker: Nova
text: [One voice answers, then another. Nova waits for the last one.] I hear them.

speaker: Nova
text: At the stair you had Jed tap the wrench twice. You remembered the sound. What happens when he says something you didn’t plan?

speaker: Vale
text: I could stop a fight before it began. Open a sealed mine before the air runs out. All I need is for the current to hold.

speaker: Vale
text: [Vale closes his hand. The voices behind him fall into time.] I can’t give it back to chance.

speaker: Nova
text: [Nova looks back at the crew.] When he tries to pull us into step, keep your own count.

speaker: Nova
text: We need a way past the patrols. Can you help?

speaker: Thorne
text: That register includes my name because I paid for everything attached to it. Read it again.

speaker: Vale
text: [The Foundry and Ring seals turn white on the flight display.] It includes the authorization you gave me at the Spire. I’ve extended it to the Ring. All sectors, lock down.

speaker: Gh0st
text: The Ring used to announce whose orders I was following. Listen. It’s stopped saying her name.

speaker: Gh0st
text: Who’s still in those seats? Open the list before you ask us for anything.

speaker: Thorne
text: [The occupied-seat list opens beside Thorne’s signature.] Keep the record. I signed those orders.

speaker: Thorne
text: I know that channel. You’ve got a whole ward on it. I can open their doors if you give me the register.

speaker: Vale
text: You’d send them back to the same rooms and charge the next ward to take their place. I can give them a world where nobody waits for a door to open.

speaker: Thorne
text: [Thorne presses her palm against the field.] One of them is still asking for her sister. Let her finish.

speaker: Nova
text: Gh0st, get to the field. I’ll hold him.

speaker: Vale
text: [Nova casts Stasis. The light stops at Vale’s feet. He lowers one finger. Thorne’s field contracts, then goes dark. She falls beside the glass.]

speaker: Gh0st
text: Thorne? [He waits for an answer. The note holds.]

speaker: Vale
text: [The Ring’s lights go out in strips. The stolen current gathers in his hand.] A choir still leaves room for someone to cry out. One voice. A solo.

speaker: Nova
text: [The glass opens onto a blue fracture. The Compliance Avatar steps between the crew and the breach.] That cable runs back to Elara. Gh0st, with me.

speaker: Gh0st
text: I thought I’d lost you. Tell me where to put my hands.

speaker: Elara
text: On the glass. There. Now help Nova lift it. I’ll open the lock from here.

speaker: Jed
text: Set it here. You fit the cold loop. I’ll hold the housing.

speaker: Nova
text: We can’t leave it here. I can take the surge.

speaker: Zeke
text: The glass can’t. Wait until I cut the return feed.

speaker: Nova
text: [Nova draws her hand back.] All right. Tell me when.

speaker: Zeke
text: [Zeke pulls the return lead. The second spike drops off the readout.] Now.

speaker: Gh0st
text: Let me read it first.

speaker: Nova
text: [Nova takes her hand off the terminal.] I’ll be here.

speaker: Nova
text: You kept the page with the handwriting.

speaker: Gh0st
text: Elara’s. Dominion pulled both of us into Project Phantom when I was small. They mapped her mind first for Harmony’s neural bridge, then put the compliance chip in me. She kept sneaking onto the ward at night to cross out their protocol sheets—and to ask whether I wanted the light left on. Then she’d wait.

speaker: Nova
text: What did you tell her?

speaker: Gh0st
text: Nothing, at first. The chip wouldn’t let me answer without an order. She came back the next night and asked again—until they flagged her as a witness risk and shipped her up to the Orbital Ring.

speaker: Gh0st
text: Do you want the light left on?

speaker: Elara
text: Please. I want to see you.

speaker: Nova
text: We’re getting them out. We’re not restoring your access.

speaker: Thorne
text: Vale has mine locked too. Open the firewall and we both get a way through.

speaker: Thorne
text: Follow the coolant pulses. Alpha, Beta, Gamma. He changed the locks, but he still needs the cooling.

speaker: Nova
text: We can wait. Do you want to go back inside?

speaker: Orion
text: No. Just let me look from here a moment. Then we’ll take the path.

speaker: Nova
text: Leave it alone. You checked it twice. Let me watch the door.

speaker: Zeke
text: [Zeke closes the scanner and puts it away.] Three times. All right. Your turn.

speaker: Nova
text: Do you want another minute?

speaker: Gh0st
text: No. Walk with me to the door.

speaker: Nova
text: You can take my hand.

speaker: Orion
text: I’d rather go slowly. Stay beside me?

speaker: Nova
text: [Nova shortens her stride.] I can do slowly.
